title: First Night at the Flagon
description: Mara Hearthstone has seen a great many strangers come through her door, and she can tell the ones who have never worked a job board. She will walk you through a night's work, one small lesson at a time. You may stop whenever you like.

talk.title: Hear Mara out
talk.objective: Talk to Mara at the bar and hear her offer. Choose a reply from the list beneath her words. Replies with a die beside them are rolled automatically. If you want more coin, ask for it.
talk.journal: Mara says I look like I've never worked a job board. She's got a rat problem and an hour to spare.

journal.title: Write it down
journal.objective: Open the journal by pressing J or using the Journal button. Find this quest, then speak to Mara again.
journal.journal: Mara says to write it down if I'm the forgetting kind. The journal keeps track for me.

errand.title: Tobin's lantern
errand.objective: Fetch Mara's lantern from Tobin at Tobin's Goods. Follow the exits on the location screen, or click the places on the map: leave the Flagon for the High Street, go up to Market Square, then enter Tobin's Goods. Talk to Tobin.
errand.journal: Tobin's holding Mara's lantern against a debt he hasn't forgotten. Out to the High Street, up to Market Square, then into his shop.

the_rats.title: Mind the third step
the_rats.objective: Return along the High Street to the Flagon, then take the Down exit to the cellar. The rats will be waiting, and the fight starts as soon as you arrive. When it's quiet, come back up and tell Mara.
the_rats.journal: I've got the lantern. The rats are in the cellar, and the third step is loose.

loot.title: Something on the floor
loot.objective: Go back down to the cellar. Press Search, then Take the item on the floor and bring it up to Mara.
loot.journal: The rats are dead. Mara says she left something in the cellar. Use Search to find it.

search.title: The draught
search.objective: Mara says she can't find the draught in the cellar. Go down and press Search again. A new way out will appear among the exits.
search.journal: There's a draught in the cellar, and Mara can't find its source. Search again to reveal what was hidden.

rest.title: Room's on the house
rest.objective: Talk to Mara and take the room she's offering. On the road, use the Camp button to rest where there's no inn.
rest.journal: I've been bleeding on Mara's floor. She's giving me a bed for the night.

done.title: That's the Flagon
done.journal: Mara showed me the Flagon's job board, the journal, the way to Tobin's, the cellar, the Search button, and the beds. The rest of Rivermark is less forgiving.

skipped.title: Got it from here
skipped.journal: Mara offered to show me around. I said I've got it from here. She went back to her cloth.
